description: This PHP source file defines the ThemeDao class, which provides data access methods for Theme entities in a Human Resource Management system, including CRUD operations for themes and retrieving theme-related images.

classes.name: ThemeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for Theme entities, providing methods to save, retrieve, delete themes and fetch theme images.

methods.name: saveTheme
methods.description: Persists a Theme entity to the database and returns the persisted theme.

methods.name: getThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a Theme entity by its name, defaulting to the system's default theme.

methods.name: getPartialThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a PartialTheme DTO for a given theme name, with a default fallback.

methods.name: deleteThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Deletes a theme identified by its name and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: getImageByImageKeyAndThemeName
methods.description: Fetches a ThemeImage DTO for a particular image key and theme name, returning null if not found or empty.
